candidates.change_summary: Change owner() to return the msg.sender instead of stored _owner, altering returned owner based on caller.
Change owner() to return address(0) always, so owner() always reports zero address.
Change owner() to return tx.origin instead of stored _owner, exposing the transaction origin as owner.
Change owner() to return address(this) (the contract address) instead of stored _owner.
Change owner() to return the hardcoded zero address when _owner is zero, otherwise return stored _owner (adds conditional observable change when owner set to non-zero).

Require newOwner can be zero address removed, allowing transferOwnership to set owner to zero even when passed zero (original required non-zero); this changes resulting owner after call when newOwner == address(0).
Relax onlyOwner check by comparing against tx.origin instead of _msgSender, so transferOwnership callable by different EOAs under some call patterns, changing who can transfer ownership.
Make onlyOwner no-op (remove owner check), so transferOwnership becomes callable by anyone, altering final owner after transferOwnership calls.
